df['daily_prod_kg'] = df['생산속도 (g/h)'] * df['가동시간 (h)'] / 1000
date_col = [c for c in df.columns if '일자' in str(c)][0]
df = df.sort_values(['반응기', date_col])
df['cum_production_kg'] = df.groupby('반응기')['daily_prod_kg'].cumsum()
